messages:
sam (AE): Quick heads-up — FinCorp verbally committed to an enterprise deal. POC week is next Tue-Wed. Need a concrete capacity + preheat plan, and clear pricing options for reserved GPUs vs burst credits. Can SEs own sizing?

jai (SE): @sam yep — can you share traffic profile? qps, avg tokens, concurrency, and the spike factor? also any model constraints (LLM size / quantized ok?)

alex (Customer Eng): Basic profile: expected steady-state ~40 qps, peak ~200 qps (5x bursts during campaigns). Avg request ~900–1200 tokens, concurrency ~120 active sessions. Primary model: 30B decoder; willing to test 13B quantized for cost.

maria (Solutions): rough calc: 200 qps @ 1k tokens -> ~200k tokens/sec peak. For 30B FP16 you'd need ~10 x A100-80GB to keep p50 < 200ms with batching+cache; 13B int8 could drop to ~4–5 x A10/A100 equiv. Suggest two options in proposal: (A) Perf-oriented reserved: 8 A100s + 4 burst for marketing spikes. (B) Cost-first: 5 A10s using 13B int8 + aggressive prefix cache + routing to smaller model on overload.

jai (SE): adding autoscale policy example to align ops and sales (this is just a template):

```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_pool_size: 2
  target_p50_latency_ms: 180
  scale_step: 2
  max_pool_size: 20
  burst_buffer: 4  # number of extra GPUs for short spikes
  preheat_window_hours: 12
```

jai (SE): Important: preheat_window_hours=12 means we prewarm KV/prefix caches and keep models resident 12h before go-live. That eliminates cold-starts for the POC.

devon (Security): Heads-up from FinCorp's security team: they want VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, SAML SSO proof, and 7-year audit log retention on request. If they insist on VPC-only control plane we should push Private deployment — that affects timeline and enclosure of reserved capacity.

sam (AE): Ok — capture two pricing scenarios in the SOW: 6-month reserved commit (discounted) + preheat add-on vs PAYG + burst credits. Finance wants simple numbers: committed monthly $ + estimated token run-rate. Can we get ballpark today?

maria (Solutions): Ballpark: Option A (reserved perf): ~$220k/mo for 8x A100 equivalent (incl baseline ops + preheat). Option B (cost optimized): ~$95k/mo for 5x A10-equivalent using 13B int8 + cache. Burst credits add-on: $10k-$30k/mo depending on burst runway. Will refine with exact instance SKU mapping.

jai (SE): Also include reliability guardrails: model-fallback routes, regional failover (AZ fallback) and request hedging. Suggested routing policy: primary -> 30B, fallback -> 13B int8 after 150ms queueing or when pool saturated.

alex (Customer Eng): FinCorp flagged one blocker: legal wants 'no shared tenancy' during processing of PII-heavy requests. They asked if Dedicated capacity + private control plane is possible within target dates.

maria (Solutions): Dedicated + Private is doable but requires 3–6 week provisioning lead time for VPC peering and KMS integration. If timeline too tight, propose a hybrid: Dedicated reserved GPUs in our VPC + encrypted transit and strict tenancy SLAs for the POC window.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled -> preheat job queued for 2026-03-30 04:00 UTC (depends on confirmation).

sam (AE): Next steps: @jai please put together a 1-pager with the two sizing lanes, autoscale snippet, and failure modes. @maria please add rough $ numbers and a timeline for Private option. @devon loop in security on SAML/KMS checklist. I'll schedule a 30m alignment call with FinCorp for EOD today.

jai (SE): On it. I'll drop a short runbook + quick perf assumptions slide in the drive and ping here when ready. :thumbsup:

maria (Solutions): I'll sync with infra to confirm preheat lead time and potential pre-provision windows. I can also run a quick benchmark on 13B int8 to validate token/sec numbers before the call.

devon (Security): I'll start the SAML/KMS questionnaire draft and flag anything that would push them to Private deployment.

sam (AE): Thanks team — quick responses here will let us finalize pricing and avoid a legal blocker.
